title: Spike: Template Scaffold Completion
purpose: Resolve that the entire Blueprint is unpopulated templates with no authored product specification.

questions.label: Real Features
questions.prompt: What are the actual features and screens of Drydock? List the FEATURE-* and SCREEN-* files that should replace the Example templates.

questions.label: Metadata and README
questions.prompt: METADATA.md and README.md (with ## Intent) are absent. What are the project name, description, stack, and one-paragraph intent that belong in them?

questions.label: COMPASS Content
questions.prompt: COMPASS.md is a single charter sentence. What belongs in ## Compass, ## Constraints, and ## Success Criteria for the Drydock methodology?
